notes.title: not just free! we will also update new content for free!
notes.notes:
I don't understand why everyone is talking about "Paranormal Campus" stabbing players in the back, as if this free offering is doomed to bring more bad than good for old players. Twenty months ago, "Paranormal Campus" embarked on its journey from Steam and started its first internal test, and the game content was then unified. Wherever this game went, players welcomed it wholeheartedly. It could really be said to have had all the favorable conditions, and that vibrant scene where everything thrived seemed still in front of our eyes. Just twenty months later, has it come to this that it has become the burial ground for "Paranormal Campus"?
Anyway, for this event, it's free access plus free content updates. The advantage is on our side!
